items.mainDefect: The migration indexes [0]['id'] on query results that may be empty, so it raises NoMethodError when the embed_category or uncategorized_category_id row is missing.

secondary.defect: The INSERT interpolates raw host values into the SQL without escaping them, so a quote or a blank line breaks it.

items.mainDefect: Admin update and destroy use where(id:).first without a nil check, so an unknown id raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a 404.

secondary.defect: The model's before_validation calls host.sub! on a host that may be nil, so a request without embeddable_host[host] raises NoMethodError.

items.mainDefect: The migration indexes execute(...)[0]['id'] with no nil check, so it raises NoMethodError when the embed_category or uncategorized_category_id row is missing.

secondary.defect: The INSERT interpolates raw setting values as '#{h}' without stripping or escaping them, so a host containing a quote breaks the insert.

items.mainDefect: before_validation calls self.host.sub! without a nil check, so creating a record without a host raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a validation error.

secondary.defect: record_for_host compares lower(host) against uri.host without downcasing it, so referers with mixed-case hosts are rejected.

items.mainDefect: Admin update and destroy use where(id:).first, which returns nil for an unknown id, so save_host(nil) or host.destroy raises NoMethodError.

secondary.defect: save_host raises an error when params[:embeddable_host] is nil.
